scope: OFFLINE only. Capture specification for parent authorization; this directory makes no HTTP/device/build calls.

requestPolicy.cookies: Do not read account/source data or cookie jars. Disable cookie attachment AND jar updates. Never log Cookie, Set-Cookie, Authorization, credentials or gallery/cursor URLs.
requestPolicy.validation: Require HTTPS, hostname exactly e-hentai.org, no userinfo, no port, no fragment, URL in exact publicInitialRequests allowlist (root trailing slash normalization only). Reject any other request before HTTP; intercept source requests locally, not by making remote requests.
requestPolicy.redirects: Disable redirects or validate every redirect before following; reject any outside exact allowlist, do not log rejected destination.
requestPolicy.bounds: At most four requests; retries=0; decoded bytes<=2097152; connect<=8000ms, read<=12000ms. Stop on 401/403; no bypass/login.
requestPolicy.capture: Write response HTML only into local private fixture file, not console/body logs. Metadata allowlist: case label, initial allowlisted URL, final URL only if allowlisted, status, content-type, UTF-8 byte length, decoded character count, SHA256, requestUserAgent, cookieJarSent=false,cookieJarUpdated=false. Never dump all headers. Save non-200 body privately if authorized to diagnose parser guards. Hash raw original HTML before any redaction; if redacted note not byte-identical.
requestPolicy.warning: Credential-free public capture can differ from the original matrix response if matrix used stored preferences/cookies. It is a template comparator, not reproduction of unknown original HTTP state. No auth/site conclusion follows from zero parsed items.
